about_short_description.short_description: Anyvite is a free site allowing users to create event invitations and organize groups for parties.

product.name: Online Invitation Creation
product.description: A web-based tool that allows users to create event invitations quickly with minimal required information.

product.name: Guest List Management
product.description: A system to build and manage guest lists by importing contacts and tracking RSVPs for events.

product.name: Ticket Sales Integration
product.description: A feature that allows event hosts to sell tickets and collect payments directly through the platform.

product.name: Calendar Integration
product.description: A service that allows users to add events directly to popular calendar applications like iCal, Google Calendar, and Outlook.

product.name: Mobile Access and Management
product.description: A mobile-friendly interface that allows users to create, manage, and update invitations and guest lists on the go.
